verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy backwards: the bold, widely spaced attribution is as heavy as the small quote and sits almost on the bottom edge. Its logo is jammed against the right edge, with 'MONOGRAPH' cramped and 'GALLERY' unreadable. B keeps the attribution subordinate and gives the logo more room, but both still have a tiny quote mark floating above the text, a large empty left third and an unreadable 'GALLERY' line.
